description: This file provides database utility functions for working with SQLite, including connection handling, query execution, and context management.

methods.name: _row_factory(cursor: sqlite3.Cursor, row: tuple)
methods.description: Converts SQLite query result rows into dictionaries with column names as keys.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Returns a new SQLite connection with foreign key support and custom row factory.

methods.name: Iterator[sqlite3.Cursor] db_cursor()
methods.description: Context manager that yields a database cursor, handling commit and rollback.

methods.name: Optional[dict] query_one(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query and returns a single result as dict or None.

methods.name: list[dict] query_all(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SELECT query and returns all results as list of dicts.

methods.name: int execute(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None)
methods.description: Executes an INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE statement, returning the last inserted row ID or 0.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> int:$/

ctags.name: query_all
ctags.pattern: /^def query_all(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> list[dict]:$/

ctags.name: query_one
ctags.pattern: /^def query_one(sql: str, params: Optional[tuple] = None) -> Optional[dict]:$/
